title: Valerian Palace

terrainReference.basis: Original source elevation at the center of the surviving mapped ruins. Below-grade trench details are estimated.

mapIdentity.scope: The four mapped vertices bound the named standing ruin, approximately 43.5 by 40.7 metres. Dominant ashlar and subordinate rubble lines are interpreted within that mapped envelope.

note: The two exact CC0 2025 exterior originals resolve the long roughly seven-course squared stone wall, open trench and overgrown foundations. Course heights and exposed floor elevations are interpreted from those views and the original ground field.
